_about: The exit checks of each phase, run by phasecheck.py in the project root. Each check: the function (check_ + its name in phasecheck.py) and its arguments; a ../ path is a file of the skill pack. 'modes' runs it only in those modes (null: no mode known), 'profiles' only for those Profile: values of plan.md. 'why' is the line of the phase's skill it rests on: the gate checks only what the skill promises, and shows the line under a failure.
